subject: Mathematics
title: Differential Equations
summary: A differential equation relates a function with its derivatives. Its order is the highest derivative present; its degree is the power of that derivative once the equation is a polynomial in derivatives.
The general solution has as many arbitrary constants as the order; a particular solution uses initial conditions.

JEE methods: variables separable, homogeneous (y = vx), and linear first-order (integrating factor). Formation of differential equations by eliminating constants and growth/decay applications also appear.

formulas.name: Order and degree
formulas.formula: order = highest derivative;  degree = power of the highest derivative (equation must be polynomial in derivatives)
formulas.note: Degree is undefined if a derivative appears inside sin, eˣ, log etc.

formulas.name: Formation of a DE
formulas.formula: differentiate as many times as there are arbitrary constants and eliminate them
formulas.note: A family with n arbitrary constants gives a DE of order n.

formulas.name: Homogeneous equation
formulas.formula: dy/dx = F(y/x): put y = vx, dy/dx = v + x dv/dx, then separate

formulas.name: Linear first-order
formulas.formula: dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x):  IF = e^{∫P dx};  y·IF = ∫Q·IF dx + C

formulas.name: Linear in x
formulas.formula: dx/dy + P(y)x = Q(y):  IF = e^{∫P dy};  x·IF = ∫Q·IF dy + C
formulas.when: When the equation is linear in x.

formulas.name: Exponential growth/decay
formulas.formula: dN/dt = kN ⇒ N = N₀e^{kt};  half-life = ln 2/|k|

formulas.name: Exact-differential tricks
formulas.formula: x dy + y dx = d(xy);  (x dy − y dx)/x² = d(y/x);  (x dy − y dx)/(x² + y²) = d(tan⁻¹(y/x))

formulas.name: Bernoulli form
formulas.formula: dy/dx + Py = Qyⁿ: divide by yⁿ and put z = y¹⁻ⁿ → linear in z

examples.title: Order and degree
examples.solution: Highest derivative y″ ⇒ order 2; its power ⇒ degree 3.

examples.title: Separable
examples.solution: dy/y = 2x dx ⇒ ln|y| = x² + c ⇒ y = Ce^{x²}.

examples.title: Linear
examples.solution: IF = eˣ ⇒ y eˣ = ∫e^{−x}eˣ dx = x + C ⇒ y = (x + C)e^{−x}.

examples.title: Growth
examples.problem: A population doubles in 10 years (dN/dt = kN). When will it triple?
examples.solution: k = ln 2/10; tripling time = ln 3/k = 10 ln 3/ln 2 ≈ 15.85 years.

examples.title: Homogeneous
examples.solution: y = vx ⇒ v + x dv/dx = 1 + v ⇒ dv = dx/x ⇒ v = ln|x| + C ⇒ y = x ln|x| + Cx.

topics.title: General vs particular solution
topics.explain: General: contains arbitrary constants equal to the order. Particular: constants fixed using given conditions. A singular solution (not from the general one) is outside the JEE Main syllabus.

topics.title: Recognising homogeneous functions
topics.explain: f(x, y) is homogeneous of degree n if f(λx, λy) = λⁿf(x, y). dy/dx = f/g is homogeneous when f and g have the same degree.

topics.title: Reducible to homogeneous
topics.explain: dy/dx = (a₁x + b₁y + c₁)/(a₂x + b₂y + c₂): shift origin x = X + h, y = Y + k to remove constants, unless a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ (then put a₁x + b₁y = t).

topics.title: Geometric applications
topics.explain: Slope of tangent = dy/dx; subtangent, subnormal and orthogonal trajectories (replace dy/dx by −dx/dy) lead to DEs.

topics.title: Checking solutions
topics.explain: Substitute the solution back into the DE — the fastest way to verify options in MCQs.

topics.title: Standard families
topics.explain: Circles through the origin with centre on x-axis, parabolas with axis along x-axis, straight lines y = mx + c (DE y″ = 0) — practise forming their DEs.

ratta: Order = highest derivative;  degree = its power.
IF = e^{∫P dx};  y·IF = ∫Q·IF dx + C.
d(xy) = x dy + y dx;  d(y/x) = (x dy − y dx)/x².
